title: Not good with shown AmazonBasics Kids Velvet Hangers
text: Not good with shown AmazonBasics Kids Velvet Hangers. Hangers are great.  Wanted clips to hang pants and skirts so ordered the suggested ones.  They are difficult to fit onto the hanger and don't open easily to insert pants/skirts.  Would not suggest buying these.

product_metadata.title: Plastic Slim-line Finger Clip Hanger Clips
features: Maximum opening size of this clip is approx 10mm.
Strong clamping force to prevent being blown off your clothes.
Perfect working with slimline hangers, ideal for thickness of 4 - 6 mm hangers.
Material: Plastic; No metal parts for protecting your delicate fabrics. Beautiful appearance and smooth edges.
Use to clip pants, shirt, skirts, bras, socks ect.
